title: Membership
description:
A Membership is a template-level eligibility statement: 'Persons of type X may hold Positions of type Y, optionally in Groups of type Z.' It captures organizational RBAC at the template level — which kinds of people can fill which kinds of positions in which kinds of groups — without binding specific person-instances. Instance-level (Joe × Father × Family-4271) bindings live in Product/Technical layers.

Membership does not share the noun base shape (no attributes, no actions). It is purely a relationship template.

name.description: The PascalCase name of this Membership template (e.g., EmployeeUnderwriter, PartnerLeadCounsel).

description.description: Human-readable explanation of who fills which position where.

person.description: The Person template eligible to hold this Position. References a declared Person.

position.description: The Position template the Person is eligible to hold. References a declared Position.

group.description: Optional Group template specifying where the Position is exercised. Required when the referenced Position has multi-scope (Position.scope is an array) and disambiguation is needed; optional when Position has a single scope or no scope. The validator resolves this against the Position's scope when both are present.

domain.description: The dot-separated domain path this Membership belongs to.

examples.name: EmployeeUnderwriter
examples.description: Employees may hold the Underwriter position (in their BankDepartment, inferred from Underwriter.scope).

examples.name: PartnerLeadCounsel
examples.description: Partners may hold the Lead Counsel position on Cases.

examples.name: EmployeeAdminWorkspace
examples.description: Employees may hold the SuperAdmin position within Workspaces (disambiguating from Tenant).
